label: SYNTHETIC_UNIT_TEST_ONLY
router: exact AST-selected frozen route_daily; no JIT

tests.scope: internal Euler timestep; public daily forcing step remains one day

rejected_cases.negative inflow: Inflow must be finite and nonnegative
rejected_cases.nonfinite inflow: Inflow must be finite and nonnegative
rejected_cases.zero tau: Residence times must be positive and finite
rejected_cases.nonfinite tau: Residence times must be positive and finite
rejected_cases.wrong reach count: Expected a one-dimensional forcing and 68 reach residence times
rejected_cases.unstable dt: Numerical stability rule violated: dt/tau must be <= 0.5
rejected_cases.negative initial state: initial_storage must be a nonnegative finite vector of length 68
rejected_cases.zero substeps: substeps must be at least one
rejected_cases.invalid tau parameter: tau0_days must be positive and finite
